11	/-!
12	# The moving lemma: pieces on which the class trivializes ((C2) effectivity, brick E4)
13	
14	**Piece selection** for the (C2) effectivity splice: for a *module-finite* faithfully
15	flat cover `A → B`, every point `x` of the base curve `X_A` admits an affine open
16	`V ∋ x` such that any prescribed Čech Picard class `L` on `X_B` restricts trivially to
17	the open subscheme `cg⁻¹ V` of the cover curve.
18	
19	The route is pure commutative algebra — no integrality of the curve, no divisors:
20	
21	* the class of `L` on a `cg`-saturated affine piece `O₀ = cg⁻¹ V₀ ∋ cg⁻¹(x)` is an
22	  invertible module `N` over `Γ(X_B, O₀)` (`Scheme.Opens.cechPicClass`, the affine
23	  dictionary `toPic` conjugated by `topIso`);
24	* the fiber of `Spec Γ(O₀) → Spec Γ(V₀)` over the germ prime of `x` is **finite** —
25	  the piece ring is module-finite over the base piece by E0's identification
26	  `Γ(O₀) ≅ Γ(V₀) ⊗[A] B` and `[Module.Finite A B]`, so the algebra is quasi-finite
27	  (`Algebra.QuasiFinite.finite_comap_preimage_singleton`);
28	* the **avoidance brick** (`Module.Invertible.exists_notMem_isUnit_free`) produces
29	  `f ∈ Γ(O₀)` avoiding every fiber prime with `N` free wherever `f` is inverted;
30	* the **algebraic tube** (`Algebra.exists_notMem_algebraMap_eq_mul`, going-up for the
31	  module-finite piece map) produces `g ∉ p_x` with `cg^♯ g = f · h`, so
32	  `V := X_A.basicOpen g ∋ x` has `cg⁻¹ V = X_B.basicOpen (cg^♯ g) ≤ X_B.basicOpen f`;
33	* freeness of `N` over `Γ(X_B, X_B.basicOpen f)` (where `f` restricts to a unit) makes
34	  the class trivial there (`Scheme.Opens.cechPicClass_basicOpen_eq_one_of_free`), and
35	  restriction triviality is monotone (`Scheme.cechPicMap_ι_eq_one_of_le`).
36	
37	The conversion of this class-level triviality into the trimmed trivializing cochain
38	(`Over.PieceTrivialization`) that the landed per-piece descent consumes is
39	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.EffectivityTrivialization`.
40	
41	## Why module-finiteness
42	
43	For a merely étale (quasi-finite, non-finite) cover the statement is **false**: the
44	bare restricted class need not trivialize on any saturated neighbourhood of a fiber
45	(e.g. `B = A_u × A_v` over a two-dimensional normal local `A` with nontrivial local
46	class group).  The general-cover effectivity therefore genuinely needs the descent
47	data, and is reached in the close through covers refined to module-finite ones (over a
48	field test every étale cover is refined by a finite separable field extension).
49	-/

66	/-! ## The class of a Čech Picard class on an affine open, and its calculus -/
67	
68	/-- Monotonicity of restriction triviality: a Čech Picard class trivial on an open
69	subscheme is trivial on every smaller open subscheme. -/
70	theorem cechPicMap_ι_eq_one_of_le {O O' : Z.Opens} (h : O' ≤ O) (L : Z.CechPic)
71	    (hL : Scheme.CechPic.map O.ι L = 1) :
72	    Scheme.CechPic.map O'.ι L = 1 := by
73	  rw [← Z.homOfLE_ι h, Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, MonoidHom.comp_apply, hL, map_one]
74	
75	/-- The identification of the sections of an open subscheme with the ambient sections,
76	as pullback along the inclusion: an isomorphism (`Restrict.lean`). -/
77	noncomputable abbrev Opens.ιTop (O : Z.Opens) : Γ(Z, O) ⟶ Γ(O, ⊤) :=
78	  O.ι.appLE O ⊤ O.ι_preimage_self.ge
79	
80	/-- The Picard class over the ambient sections `Γ(Z, O)` of the restriction of a Čech
81	Picard class to an affine open subscheme: the affine dictionary `toPic` conjugated by
82	the section identification. -/
83	noncomputable def Opens.cechPicClass (O : Z.Opens) (hO : IsAffineOpen O)
84	    (L : Z.CechPic) : CommRing.Pic Γ(Z, O) :=
85	  haveI : IsAffine (O : Scheme.{u}) := hO
86	  CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom (inv O.ιTop).hom
87	    (Scheme.CechPic.toPic O.toScheme (Scheme.CechPic.map O.ι L))
88	
89	/-- Transport along a ring homomorphism with a left inverse reflects triviality in the
90	Picard group. -/
91	private lemma pic_eq_one_of_mapRingHom {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
92	    {φ : R →+* S} {ψ : S →+* R} (hψφ : ψ.comp φ = RingHom.id R) {M : CommRing.Pic R}
93	    (h : CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom φ M = 1) : M = 1 := by
94	  have h2 := congrArg (CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom ψ) h
95	  rw [map_one, CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom_mapRingHom, hψφ,
96	    ← Algebra.algebraMap_self (R := R), CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom_algebraMap,
97	    CommRing.Pic.mapAlgebra_self_apply] at h2
98	  exact h2
99	
100	/-- Triviality of the affine-open class detects restriction triviality. -/
101	theorem Opens.cechPicMap_ι_eq_one_of_cechPicClass_eq_one {O : Z.Opens}
102	    (hO : IsAffineOpen O) {L : Z.CechPic} (h : O.cechPicClass hO L = 1) :
103	    Scheme.CechPic.map O.ι L = 1 := by
104	  haveI : IsAffine (O : Scheme.{u}) := hO
105	  apply Scheme.CechPic.toPic_injective (X := O.toScheme)
106	  rw [map_one]
107	  refine pic_eq_one_of_mapRingHom (φ := (inv O.ιTop).hom) (ψ := O.ιTop.hom) ?_ h
108	  have : inv O.ιTop ≫ O.ιTop = 𝟙 _ := IsIso.inv_hom_id _
109	  have h2 := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom this
110	  rwa [CommRingCat.hom_comp] at h2
111	
112	/-- Congruence in the morphism for `appLE`, at the `CommRingCat` level. -/
113	private lemma appLE_hom_congr {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f f' : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f = f')
114	    {V : Y.Opens} {O : X.Opens} (e : O ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (e' : O ≤ f' ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
115	    f.appLE V O e = f'.appLE V O e' := by
116	  subst hf; rfl
117	
118	/-- **The restriction seam of the affine-open class**: for affine opens `O' ≤ O`, the
119	class of the restriction to `O'` is the image of the class on `O` under the restriction
120	map of ambient sections — the `appLE` square of the two inclusions. -/
121	theorem Opens.cechPicClass_of_le {O O' : Z.Opens} (hO : IsAffineOpen O)
122	    (hO' : IsAffineOpen O') (h : O' ≤ O) (L : Z.CechPic) :
123	    O'.cechPicClass hO' L
124	      = CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
125	          (O.cechPicClass hO L) := by
126	  haveI : IsAffine (O : Scheme.{u}) := hO
127	  haveI : IsAffine (O' : Scheme.{u}) := hO'
128	  -- the `appLE` square of the two inclusions
129	  have hsq : O.ιTop ≫ (Z.homOfLE h).appTop = Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op ≫ O'.ιTop := by
130	    have hle : (⊤ : (O' : Scheme.{u}).Opens) ≤ O'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ O :=
131	      O'.ι_preimage_self.ge.trans (O'.ι.preimage_mono h)
132	    have h1 : O.ιTop ≫ (Z.homOfLE h).appTop
133	        = (Z.homOfLE h ≫ O.ι).appLE O ⊤ (by rw [Z.homOfLE_ι]; exact hle) := by
134	      rw [show (Z.homOfLE h).appTop = (Z.homOfLE h).appLE ⊤ ⊤
135	          (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (Z.homOfLE h)).ge from
136	          (Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app (Z.homOfLE h)).symm]
137	      exact Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE _ _ _ _ _ _ _
138	    have h2 : Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op ≫ O'.ιTop = O'.ι.appLE O ⊤ hle :=
139	      Scheme.Hom.map_appLE _ _ _
140	    rw [h1, h2]
141	    exact appLE_hom_congr (Z.homOfLE_ι h) _ _
142	  -- unfold both classes and chase the square
143	  rw [Opens.cechPicClass, Opens.cechPicClass, ← Z.homOfLE_ι h,
144	    Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, MonoidHom.comp_apply,
145	    Scheme.CechPic.toPic_map (Z.homOfLE h), CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom_mapRingHom,
146	    CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom_mapRingHom]
147	  -- turn the square into the inverse form
148	  have hinv : (Z.homOfLE h).appTop ≫ inv O'.ιTop
149	      = inv O.ιTop ≫ Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op := by
150	    rw [IsIso.comp_inv_eq, Category.assoc, ← hsq, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
151	  refine congrArg (fun ψ => CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom ψ
152	    (Scheme.CechPic.toPic O.toScheme (Scheme.CechPic.map O.ι L))) ?_
153	  have h3 := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hinv
154	  rwa [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp] at h3

156	/-- **Freeness trivializes the class on a basic open**: if the invertible module of the
157	class on an affine `O` becomes free over every algebra inverting `f`, the class on the
158	basic open of `f` is trivial. -/
159	theorem Opens.cechPicClass_basicOpen_eq_one_of_free {O : Z.Opens}
160	    (hO : IsAffineOpen O) (L : Z.CechPic) (f : Γ(Z, O))
161	    (hfree : ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra Γ(Z, O) S],
162	      IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(Z, O) S f) →
163	        Module.Free S (S ⊗[Γ(Z, O)] (O.cechPicClass hO L).AsModule)) :
164	    (Z.basicOpen f).cechPicClass (hO.basicOpen f) L = 1 := by
165	  rw [Opens.cechPicClass_of_le hO (hO.basicOpen f) (Z.basicOpen_le f) L]
166	  letI := (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE (Z.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom.toAlgebra
167	  have hres : CommRing.Pic.mapRingHom
168	        (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE (Z.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom (O.cechPicClass hO L)
169	      = CommRing.Pic.mapAlgebra Γ(Z, O) Γ(Z, Z.basicOpen f) (O.cechPicClass hO L) :=
170	    rfl
171	  have hunit : IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(Z, O) Γ(Z, Z.basicOpen f) f) :=
172	    Z.toRingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen f
173	  haveI := hfree Γ(Z, Z.basicOpen f) hunit
174	  rw [hres, CommRing.Pic.mapAlgebra_apply]
175	  exact CommRing.Pic.mk_eq_one _ _

17	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.cechPicEquivPic : X.CechPic ≃* CommRing.Pic Γ(X, ⊤)`

20	and mathlib's Picard group of invertible modules (the TODO of
21	`Mathlib.RingTheory.PicardGroup`: "exhibit isomorphism with `H¹(Spec R, 𝓞ˣ)`").

23	The route: an invertible module `N` over `Γ(X, ⊤)` trivializes on the basic open of
24	some section outside every prime, so the trivializing sections span the unit ideal
25	(`Module.Invertible.span_tensor_free_eq_top`) and their basic opens cover `X`.  A
26	choice of one trivializing basic neighborhood per point is a `TrivializingFamily`; the
27	transition units of its trivializations (`Module.transitionUnit`) form a unit Čech
28	cocycle on the associated pointed cover.  Along any finite basic refinement the
29	restricted cover cocycle is the transition cocycle of the pushed-forward
30	trivializations, so its descended module is `N` itself
31	(`IsLocalization.AwayCover.picClass_trivializationCocycle`), and `toPic` hits the class
32	of `N`.

50	/-- A pointed trivializing family for a module `N` over the global sections of `X`: one
51	section per point, whose basic open contains the point and carries a trivialization of
52	the base change of `N`.  Invertible modules over affine schemes always admit one
53	(`TrivializingFamily.nonempty`). -/
54	structure TrivializingFamily (X : Scheme.{u}) (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N]
55	    [Module Γ(X, ⊤) N] : Type u where
56	  /-- The trivializing section at a point. -/
57	  sec : X → Γ(X, ⊤)
58	  /-- Each point lies in the basic open of its section. -/
59	  mem_basicOpen : ∀ x, x ∈ X.basicOpen (sec x)
60	  /-- The chosen trivialization of `N` over the basic open. -/
61	  triv : ∀ x, (Γ(X, X.basicOpen (sec x)) ⊗[Γ(X, ⊤)] N)
62	    ≃ₗ[Γ(X, X.basicOpen (sec x))] Γ(X, X.basicOpen (sec x))

68	/-- Every invertible module over the global sections of an affine scheme admits a
69	trivializing family: the trivializing sections span the unit ideal, so their basic
70	opens cover `X`. -/
71	theorem nonempty [IsAffine X] [Module.Invertible Γ(X, ⊤) N] :
72	    Nonempty (TrivializingFamily X N) := by
73	  have hcover :
74	      (⨆ f : {f : Γ(X, ⊤) | ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra Γ(X, ⊤) S],
75	          IsLocalization.Away f S → Module.Free S (S ⊗[Γ(X, ⊤)] N)},
76	        X.basicOpen f.1) = ⊤ :=
77	    (isAffineOpen_top X).iSup_basicOpen_eq_self_iff.mpr
78	      (Module.Invertible.span_tensor_free_eq_top N)
79	  have hex : ∀ x : X, ∃ f : Γ(X, ⊤),
80	      (∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra Γ(X, ⊤) S],
81	        IsLocalization.Away f S → Module.Free S (S ⊗[Γ(X, ⊤)] N))
82	      ∧ x ∈ X.basicOpen f := by
83	    intro x
84	    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (hcover.ge (trivial : x ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens)))
85	    exact ⟨f.1, f.2, hf⟩
86	  choose f hfree hmem using hex
87	  refine ⟨⟨f, hmem, fun x ↦ ?_⟩⟩
88	  haveI : Module.Free Γ(X, X.basicOpen (f x)) (Γ(X, X.basicOpen (f x)) ⊗[Γ(X, ⊤)] N) :=
89	    hfree x Γ(X, X.basicOpen (f x)) inferInstance
90	  exact (Module.Invertible.free_iff_linearEquiv.mp this).some

107	/-- The transition cocycle of the trivializing family: on each double overlap, the
108	transition unit between the pushforwards of the trivializations at the two points. -/
109	noncomputable def transition (x y : X) : Γ(X, X.basicOpen (F.sec x * F.sec y))ˣ :=
110	  IsLocalization.AwayCover.trivializationCocycle F.sec
111	    (fun x ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (F.sec x)))
112	    (fun x y ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (F.sec x * F.sec y))) F.triv x y

115	trivializing basic opens. -/
116	lemma isCoverCocycle_transition :
117	    IsLocalization.AwayCover.IsCoverCocycle (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := F.sec)
118	      (S := fun x ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (F.sec x)))
119	      (T := fun x y ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (F.sec x * F.sec y)))
120	      (W := fun x y z ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (F.sec x * (F.sec y * F.sec z))))

122	  IsLocalization.AwayCover.isCoverCocycle_trivializationCocycle F.sec _ _ _ F.triv
123	
124	/-- The cocycle identity for the transition units, restricted to any common open. -/
125	lemma transition_mul (x y z : X) {T : X.Opens}
126	    (hxy : T ≤ X.basicOpen (F.sec x * F.sec y))
127	    (hyz : T ≤ X.basicOpen (F.sec y * F.sec z))
128	    (hxz : T ≤ X.basicOpen (F.sec x * F.sec z)) :
129	    X.unitsRestrict hxy (F.transition x y) * X.unitsRestrict hyz (F.transition y z)
130	      = X.unitsRestrict hxz (F.transition x z) := by
131	  -- restrictions from the double overlaps to the triple overlap
132	  have h₁₂ : X.basicOpen (F.sec x * (F.sec y * F.sec z))
133	      ≤ X.basicOpen (F.sec x * F.sec y) :=
134	    X.basicOpen_le_of_dvd ⟨F.sec z, by ring⟩
135	  have h₂₃ : X.basicOpen (F.sec x * (F.sec y * F.sec z))
136	      ≤ X.basicOpen (F.sec y * F.sec z) :=
137	    X.basicOpen_le_of_dvd ⟨F.sec x, by ring⟩
138	  have h₁₃ : X.basicOpen (F.sec x * (F.sec y * F.sec z))
139	      ≤ X.basicOpen (F.sec x * F.sec z) :=
140	    X.basicOpen_le_of_dvd ⟨F.sec y, by ring⟩
141	  -- the common open sits inside the triple overlap
142	  have hT : T ≤ X.basicOpen (F.sec x * (F.sec y * F.sec z)) := by
143	    rw [X.basicOpen_mul, X.basicOpen_mul]
144	    exact le_inf (hxy.trans ((X.basicOpen_mul _ _).trans_le inf_le_left))
145	      (le_inf (hxy.trans ((X.basicOpen_mul _ _).trans_le inf_le_right))
146	        (hyz.trans ((X.basicOpen_mul _ _).trans_le inf_le_right)))
147	  -- the cover cocycle identity, with the face maps rewritten as restrictions
148	  have hc := (F.isCoverCocycle_transition).cocycle x y z
149	  rw [show IsLocalization.AwayCover.face₂₃ (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := F.sec)
150	        (T := fun x y ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (F.sec x * F.sec y)))
151	        (W := fun x y z ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (F.sec x * (F.sec y * F.sec z)))) x y z
152	      = X.basicRes _ _ h₂₃ from X.basicOpen_algHom_ext _ _ _,
153	    show IsLocalization.AwayCover.face₁₂ (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := F.sec)
154	        (T := fun x y ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (F.sec x * F.sec y)))
155	        (W := fun x y z ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (F.sec x * (F.sec y * F.sec z)))) x y z
156	      = X.basicRes _ _ h₁₂ from X.basicOpen_algHom_ext _ _ _,
157	    show IsLocalization.AwayCover.face₁₃ (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := F.sec)
158	        (T := fun x y ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (F.sec x * F.sec y)))
159	        (W := fun x y z ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (F.sec x * (F.sec y * F.sec z)))) x y z
160	      = X.basicRes _ _ h₁₃ from X.basicOpen_algHom_ext _ _ _] at hc
161	  -- lift to units on the triple overlap
162	  have hu : X.unitsRestrict h₂₃ (F.transition y z) * X.unitsRestrict h₁₂ (F.transition x y)
163	      = X.unitsRestrict h₁₃ (F.transition x z) := Units.ext hc
164	  -- restrict to `T` and collapse the composed restrictions
165	  have e := congrArg (X.unitsRestrict hT) hu
166	  rw [map_mul, unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict, unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict,
167	    unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict] at e
168	  exact (mul_comm _ _).trans e

170	/-- The unit Čech cocycle of a trivializing family on its pointed cover: the value on
171	`T ≤ D(sec x) ⊓ D(sec y)` is the restriction of the transition unit. -/
172	noncomputable def cocycle : X.unitsCocycle F.cover where
173	  ev x y _ a b :=
174	    X.unitsRestrict ((le_inf a.le b.le).trans (X.basicOpen_mul (F.sec x) (F.sec y)).ge)
175	      (F.transition x y)
176	  ev_precomp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ := unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict _ _ _
177	  ev_trans x y z _ a b c :=
178	    F.transition_mul x y z
179	      ((le_inf a.le b.le).trans (X.basicOpen_mul (F.sec x) (F.sec y)).ge)
180	      ((le_inf b.le c.le).trans (X.basicOpen_mul (F.sec y) (F.sec z)).ge)
181	      ((le_inf a.le c.le).trans (X.basicOpen_mul (F.sec x) (F.sec z)).ge)

183	/-- The pair values of the trivializing cocycle are the restricted transition units. -/
184	lemma cocycle_unitsEvInf (x y : X) :
185	    unitsEvInf F.cocycle x y
186	      = X.unitsRestrict (X.basicOpen_mul (F.sec x) (F.sec y)).ge (F.transition x y) :=
187	  rfl

191	/-- The trivializations of the family, pushed forward to a basic refinement of the
192	trivializing cover. -/
193	noncomputable def refTriv (P : F.cover.BasicRefinement) (i : P.ι) :
194	    (Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i)) ⊗[Γ(X, ⊤)] N)
195	      ≃ₗ[Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i))] Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i)) :=
196	  Module.trivializationPush (X.basicRes _ _ (P.basicOpen_le i)) (F.triv (P.pt i))

198	/-- Restricting the trivializing cocycle to a basic refinement recovers the transition
199	cocycle of the pushed trivializations. -/
200	lemma coverCocycle_eq (P : F.cover.BasicRefinement) (i j : P.ι) :
201	    P.coverCocycle F.cocycle i j
202	      = IsLocalization.AwayCover.trivializationCocycle P.r
203	          (fun i ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i)))
204	          (fun i j ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r j))) (F.refTriv P) i j := by
205	  have hle : X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r j)
206	      ≤ X.basicOpen (F.sec (P.pt i) * F.sec (P.pt j)) :=
207	    (P.overlap_le i j).trans (X.basicOpen_mul _ _).ge
208	  have h₁ : P.coverCocycle F.cocycle i j
209	      = X.unitsRestrict hle (F.transition (P.pt i) (P.pt j)) :=
210	    unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict (X.basicOpen_mul (F.sec (P.pt i)) (F.sec (P.pt j))).ge
211	      (P.overlap_le i j) (F.transition (P.pt i) (P.pt j))
212	  rw [h₁, IsLocalization.AwayCover.trivializationCocycle, refTriv, refTriv,
213	    Module.trivializationPush_trivializationPush,
214	    Module.trivializationPush_trivializationPush,
215	    show (IsLocalization.AwayCover.inclLeft (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := P.r)
216	        (S := fun i ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i)))
217	        (T := fun i j ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r j))) i j).comp
218	          (X.basicRes _ _ (P.basicOpen_le i))
219	      = (X.basicRes _ _ hle).comp
220	          (IsLocalization.AwayCover.inclLeft (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := F.sec)
221	            (S := fun x ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (F.sec x)))
222	            (T := fun x y ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (F.sec x * F.sec y))) (P.pt i) (P.pt j))
223	      from X.basicOpen_algHom_ext _ _ _,
224	    show (IsLocalization.AwayCover.inclRight (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := P.r)
225	        (S := fun i ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i)))
226	        (T := fun i j ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r j))) i j).comp
227	          (X.basicRes _ _ (P.basicOpen_le j))
228	      = (X.basicRes _ _ hle).comp
229	          (IsLocalization.AwayCover.inclRight (A := Γ(X, ⊤)) (f := F.sec)
230	            (S := fun x ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (F.sec x)))
231	            (T := fun x y ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (F.sec x * F.sec y))) (P.pt i) (P.pt j))
232	      from X.basicOpen_algHom_ext _ _ _,
233	    ← Module.trivializationPush_trivializationPush,
234	    ← Module.trivializationPush_trivializationPush,
235	    Module.map_transitionUnit]
236	  rfl

239	trivializing cocycle is the class of `N` itself. -/
240	theorem pic_cocycle [Module.Invertible Γ(X, ⊤) N] (P : F.cover.BasicRefinement) :
241	    P.pic F.cocycle = CommRing.Pic.mk Γ(X, ⊤) N := by
242	  letI := P.faithfullyFlat
243	  rw [P.pic_eq_picClass]
244	  refine (Module.IsDescentCocycle.picClass_congr _
245	      (IsLocalization.AwayCover.isDescentCocycle_cocycleUnit _ _ _
246	        (fun i j k ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * (P.r j * P.r k))))
247	        (IsLocalization.AwayCover.isCoverCocycle_trivializationCocycle P.r _ _
248	          (fun i j k ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * (P.r j * P.r k))))
249	          (F.refTriv P)))
250	      (congrArg _ (funext fun i ↦ funext fun j ↦ F.coverCocycle_eq P i j))).trans
251	    (IsLocalization.AwayCover.picClass_trivializationCocycle P.r _ _
252	      (fun i j k ↦ Γ(X, X.basicOpen (P.r i * (P.r j * P.r k)))) (F.refTriv P))

264	/-- **Surjectivity of the Čech–Picard descent homomorphism**: every class of invertible
265	modules over the global sections arises from a unit Čech cocycle on a trivializing
266	pointed cover. -/
267	theorem toPic_surjective : Function.Surjective (toPic X) := by
268	  intro c
269	  obtain ⟨F⟩ := TrivializingFamily.nonempty (X := X) (N := c.AsModule)
270	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := PointedCover.BasicRefinement.nonempty F.cover
271	  refine ⟨CechPic.mk F.cover (OneCocycle.class F.cocycle), ?_⟩
272	  rw [toPic_mk F.cover F.cocycle P, F.pic_cocycle P, CommRing.Pic.mk_eq_self]
273	
274	/-- The Čech–Picard descent homomorphism of an affine scheme is an isomorphism. -/
275	theorem toPic_bijective : Function.Bijective (toPic X) :=
276	  ⟨toPic_injective, toPic_surjective X⟩
277	
278	end CechPic

284	    X.CechPic ≃* CommRing.Pic Γ(X, ⊤) :=

9	/-!
10	# Affine two-chart covers, and their pullback along the base-change projection
11	
12	An **affine two-chart cover** of a scheme `Y` (`Scheme.AffineTwoCover`) is a pair of affine
13	opens `V₀, V₁` covering `Y` whose overlap `V₀ ⊓ V₁` is again affine. This file provides:
14	
15	* the structure `Scheme.AffineTwoCover`;
16	* **existence** for the challenge curve: the smooth, proper, geometrically irreducible curve
17	  `C/k` admits an affine two-chart cover (`Scheme.AffineTwoCover.nonempty_of_curve`), obtained
18	  as the preimages of the two standard charts of `ℙ¹` under a finite `k`-morphism `C ⟶ ℙ¹`
19	  (`exists_isFinite_toP1`, `AlgebraicJacobian.Curve.MapToP1`); the overlap is affine because it
20	  is the preimage of the affine chart overlap `D₊(X₀X₁)`;
21	* **stability under base change**: an affine two-chart cover of `C.left` pulls back, along the
22	  first projection `(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left ⟶ C.left`, to an affine two-chart cover of
23	  `(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left`, for any `k`-algebra `R` (`Scheme.AffineTwoCover.pullbackProd`).
24	  The key input is that the first projection is an affine morphism: it is the base change of
25	  `overSpec k R ⟶ Spec k` (itself affine, being a morphism between affine schemes) along
26	  `C.hom` (`Over.isAffineHom_fst_left`), and preimages of affine opens under an affine
27	  morphism are affine.
28	
29	## Main declarations
30	
31	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineTwoCover` — the structure.
32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineTwoCover.nonempty_of_curve` — existence for the curve.
33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isAffineHom_fst_left` — the first projection of a base change along
34	  an affine morphism is affine.
35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineTwoCover.pullbackProd` — the pullback of an affine two-chart
36	  cover along the first projection `(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left ⟶ C.left`.
37	-/

13	For a scheme `X` with two opens `V₀ ⊔ V₁ = ⊤`, the two-chart Čech cohomology of units

15	```

22	## Why this file exists: clauses (iii-a) and (iii-b), which are not about dual numbers

25	the Kleiman §5 Thm. 5.11 dimension identity — into three parts, and observes that **two of
26	them contain no dual numbers, no curves and no `H¹`**. Those two are exactly this file:

29	* **(iii-b)** it is injective.
30

32	that generality rather than at `C ×_k Spec k[ε]`. The remaining part, **(iii-c)**
33	(surjectivity onto the `ε`-kernel), is the only one that needs the thickening; it consumes
34	`DualNumber.free_of_cyclic_mod_eps` and lives elsewhere.

43	`CechPic` is built on **pointed** covers — one open per point — so a two-open cover enters
44	through a selector `sel : X → Bool` with `x ∈ V (sel x)`, exactly as
45	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.pieceIndex` and `thetaFieldChartIndex` do elsewhere in the tree.
46	Indexing the charts by `Bool` (rather than by two named opens) is what makes the cocycle law a
47	`cases`-bash that closes uniformly.

297	      (X.resHom (inf_le_right : V false ⊓ V true ≤ V true)) := by

20	  two-chart cover* is `twoChartClassHom u` for some `u`;

25	## The normalization, and why it carries no transport
26	
27	`γ` need not be normalized: at a pair `(x, y)` with `sel x = sel y` its value is an
28	arbitrary unit on `V (sel x)`, whereas `twoChartPairUnit` is `1` there. The worksheet
29	predicted the conjugating `0`-cochain `x ↦ γ.evInf x (base (sel x))` would need its type
30	rewritten (`inf_idem`) and that the four `Bool` cases would each need a `subst`.
31	
32	**That cost is avoidable, and this file is the record of how.** Take the `0`-cochain
33	
34	```
35	normCochain x := (X.unitsRestrict (le_inf le_rfl (hmem …)) (γ.evInf x (base (sel x))))⁻¹
36	```
37	
38	Restricting `γ.evInf x (base (sel x))` — which lives on `V (sel x) ⊓ V (sel (base (sel x)))`

40	`V (sel x)` **on the nose**. No `rw` in a type, no `subst`, because an inequality of opens
41	is a `Prop` and proof irrelevance does the work that `inf_idem` was being asked to do. The
42	`hbase : sel (base s) = s` hypothesis is then needed only to *identify* the resulting
43	overlap unit with the candidate, i.e. inside `Prop`, where `subst` is free.
44

46	`Bool` cases: `γ.evInf x (base s) ⁻¹ · γ.evInf x y · γ.evInf y (base t)` restricted to

theorem twoChartClassHom_mk_range (sel : X → Bool) (hmem : ∀ x, x ∈ V (sel x))
    {base : Bool → X} (hbase : ∀ s, sel (base s) = s)
    (a : X.unitsH1 (twoChartCover V sel hmem)) :
    ∃ u : Γ(X, V false ⊓ V true)ˣ,
      twoChartClassHom V sel hmem u = Scheme.CechPic.mk (twoChartCover V sel hmem) a := by
  induction a using Quot.ind with
  | _ γ =>
    refine ⟨twoChartCandidate sel hmem γ (hbase false) (hbase true), ?_⟩
    rw [twoChartClassHom_apply]

      (twoChartCocycle_isCohomologous sel hmem hbase γ).class_eq.symm

with `twoChartClass_injective` the map is a bijection onto the classes representable on the
two-chart cover. -/
theorem twoChartClass_mk_range (sel : X → Bool) (hmem : ∀ x, x ∈ V (sel x))
    (hsel : Function.Surjective sel) (a : X.unitsH1 (twoChartCover V sel hmem)) :
    ∃ q, twoChartClass V sel hmem hsel q
      = Scheme.CechPic.mk (twoChartCover V sel hmem) a := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ :=
    twoChartClassHom_mk_range sel hmem (Function.surjInv_eq hsel) a

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.OpenImmersionUnits
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.RefinementInjectivity

/-!
# Separation of Čech Picard classes along a clopen partition

For a scheme `Y` partitioned by the images of finitely-or-infinitely many open
immersions `w i : Z i ⟶ Y` with pairwise disjoint ranges covering `Y` (a *clopen
partition* — each range is open with open complement), two Čech Picard classes on `Y`
agreeing on every piece agree
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CechPic.eq_of_map_eq_of_clopen`).

Route: represent both classes on a common pointed cover refined so that the member at
`y` lies inside the piece of `y`; the ratio class pulls back to a coboundary on each
piece (`CechPic.mk_injective` — refinement injectivity), and the cobounding units
descend through the section equivalence of the open immersions
(`Scheme.Hom.unitsPreimageEquiv`) to a coboundary on `Y` itself: overlaps of members
from different pieces are empty, so only the single-piece coboundary relations matter,
and those transport across `w i` by injectivity of pullback on opens inside the range.

This is the exact clopen analogue of the projection-descent step of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Over.prPullback_injective` (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Separatedness`).
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Opposite CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Scheme

variable {ι : Type u} {Y : Scheme.{u}} {Z : ι → Scheme.{u}} (w : ∀ i, Z i ⟶ Y)
  [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (w i)]

/-- The descent step for the clopen separation, with the piece points and the descended
units abstracted (the clopen mirror of `Over.descend_coboundary` in
`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Separatedness`): if the pullback to the piece `Z i` of a unit
cocycle `γ` on `𝒱` is the coboundary of `α`, and `βy, βy'` pull back to the values of
`α` at points `z, z'` over `y, y'`, then `βy, βy'` satisfy the coboundary relation for
`γ` at `(y, y')` — provided both members of the cover lie inside the range of the
piece. -/
private lemma clopen_descend_coboundary {i : ι} {𝒱 : Y.PointedCover}
    (γ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒱)
    (α : ∀ z : Z i, Γ(Z i, (𝒱.pullback (w i)).opens z)ˣ)
    (hα : ∀ z z',
      (Z i).unitsRestrict
          (inf_le_left : (𝒱.pullback (w i)).opens z ⊓ (𝒱.pullback (w i)).opens z'
            ≤ (𝒱.pullback (w i)).opens z) (α z)
          * Scheme.unitsEvInf ((w i).pullbackUnitsCocycle γ) z z'
        = (Z i).unitsRestrict inf_le_right (α z'))
    (z z' : Z i) (y y' : Y)
    (hz : (w i).base z = y) (hz' : (w i).base z' = y')
..... 95-135
      (w i) ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒱.opens ((w i).base z) ⊓ 𝒱.opens ((w i).base z'))
        ≤ (𝒱.pullback (w i)).opens z ⊓ (𝒱.pullback (w i)).opens z')) (hα z z')
  erw [map_mul, Scheme.unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict, Scheme.unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict,
    Scheme.Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_unitsEvInf, Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map] at e₃
  -- assemble
  rw [Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE, Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE, e₁, e₂]
  exact e₃

/-- The core of the clopen separation, at the level of `H¹` classes on an adapted
pointed cover: a class on a cover whose member at `y` lies inside the range of the piece
of `y` and whose pullback to every piece is trivial is trivial. -/
private lemma unitsH1_eq_one_of_pieces (piece : Y → ι)
    (hdisj : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (w i).opensRange ⊓ (w j).opensRange = ⊥)
    (hpiece : ∀ y, y ∈ (w (piece y)).opensRange)
    {𝒱 : Y.PointedCover} (h𝒱 : ∀ y, 𝒱.opens y ≤ (w (piece y)).opensRange)
    (b : Y.unitsH1 𝒱) (hb : ∀ i, (w i).pullbackUnitsH1 𝒱 b = 1) :
    b = 1 := by
  induction b using Quot.ind with | _ γ =>
  -- extract the piece coboundaries
  have hstep : ∀ i : ι, ∃ α : ∀ z : Z i, Γ(Z i, (𝒱.pullback (w i)).opens z)ˣ,
      ∀ z z',
        (Z i).unitsRestrict
            (inf_le_left : (𝒱.pullback (w i)).opens z ⊓ (𝒱.pullback (w i)).opens z'
              ≤ (𝒱.pullback (w i)).opens z) (α z)
            * Scheme.unitsEvInf ((w i).pullbackUnitsCocycle γ) z z'
          = (Z i).unitsRestrict inf_le_right (α z') := by
    intro i
    have h1 : ((w i).pullbackUnitsCocycle γ).class = OneCocycle.class 1 := hb i
    obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := (OneCocycle.isCohomologous_iff_evInf _ _).mp
      ((OneCocycle.class_eq_iff _ _).mp h1)
    refine ⟨α, fun z z' => ?_⟩
    have h2 := hα z z'
    rw [OneCocycle.one_evInf, one_mul] at h2
    exact h2
  choose α hα using hstep
  -- glue the piece coboundaries to a coboundary on `Y`
  have hglue : ∀ y : Y, ∃ βy : Γ(Y, 𝒱.opens y)ˣ,
      ∀ (i : ι) (z : Z i) (hz : (w i).base z = y)
        (hzle : (w i) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒱.opens y ≤ (𝒱.pullback (w i)).opens z),
        (w i).unitsAppLE (𝒱.opens y) ((w i) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒱.opens y) le_rfl βy
          = (Z i).unitsRestrict hzle (α i z) := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mp (hpiece y)
    refine ⟨(Scheme.Hom.unitsPreimageEquiv (w (piece y)) (h𝒱 y)).symm
      ((Z (piece y)).unitsRestrict
        (le_of_eq (congrArg (fun t => (w (piece y)) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒱.opens t) hz₀.symm))

*Added later in the same session, after (iii-a)/(iii-b) landed (commits `428d0d4f7`,

and probing it showed it is **two** statements, exactly as clause (iii) was three:

| part | statement | dual numbers? |
|---|---|---|
| **(iii-c1)** | every class *representable on the two-chart cover* is in the range of `twoChartClassHom` | **NO** — general Čech theory, like (iii-a)/(iii-b) |

**(iii-c1) is a normalization statement, and the obstacle is genuine.** A general
`γ : X.unitsCocycle (twoChartCover V sel hmem)` is *not* of the form `twoChartCocycle u`: its
value at a pair `(x, x')` with `sel x = sel x'` lives on `V s ⊓ V s = V s` and is an arbitrary

does not help**: it forces the value to `1` only when the two *indices* coincide, not when
their *opens* do — and on a pointed cover many points share a chart. So the same-chart values
are real data that must be normalized away.

The normalization is by an explicit `0`-cochain. Choose base points `base s` with
`sel (base s) = s` (this is where `Function.Surjective sel` is used a *second* time), and set

```
β x := γ.evInf x (base (sel x))    ∈ Γ(X, V (sel x))ˣ
```

— the type works out because `V (sel x) ⊓ V (sel (base (sel x))) = V (sel x) ⊓ V (sel x)` is
`V (sel x)` by `inf_idem`. **Type-checked by machine this session** (the `rw [twoChartCover_opens,
twoChartCover_opens, hbase, inf_idem]` chain elaborates). Conjugating `γ` by `β` kills the
same-chart values by the cocycle law, leaving a cocycle determined by its value at
`(base false, base true)`, which is the `u` wanted.

abstract the chart index as a variable and `subst` — but it has to be done for each

**trimmed trivializing cochain** — one unit on each `D`-trimmed member `𝒩.opens b ⊓ D`,

relation.  Instantiated at `D = cg⁻¹ V`, this is exactly an `Over.PieceTrivialization`,

appears) gives a trivializing `0`-cochain `α` of the pulled-back cocycle, indexed by the

namespace Scheme

variable {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}

/-! ## The Picard group  -/

instance cechPicSetoid (X : Scheme.{u}) : Setoid (Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰) where
  r p q := ∃ (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ p.1) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ q.1),
    unitsRes h₁ p.2 = unitsRes h₂ q.2
  iseqv := by
    constructor
    · exact fun p ↦ ⟨p.1, le_rfl, le_rfl, rfl⟩
    · rintro p q ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩
      exact ⟨𝒲, h₂, h₁, e.symm⟩
    · rintro p q r ⟨𝒲₁, h₁, h₂, e₁⟩ ⟨𝒲₂, h₃, h₄, e₂⟩
      refine ⟨𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂, inf_le_left.trans h₁, inf_le_right.trans h₄, ?_⟩
      have e₁' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₁)) e₁
      have e₂' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_right : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₂)) e₂
      simp only [unitsRes_unitsRes] at e₁' e₂'
      exact e₁'.trans e₂'

/-- The definitional Picard group of a scheme: Čech `H¹` of the units presheaf,
stabilized along refinement of pointed covers. -/
def CechPic (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u :=
  Quotient (cechPicSetoid X)

namespace CechPic

/-- The Picard class of a unit Čech `H¹` class on a pointed cover. -/
def mk (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) : X.CechPic :=
  ⟦⟨𝒰, a⟩⟧

@[elab_as_elim]
theorem ind {motive : X.CechPic → Prop}
    (mk : ∀ (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰), motive (mk 𝒰 a)) (x : X.CechPic) :
    motive x :=
  Quotient.ind (fun p ↦ by obtain ⟨𝒰, a⟩ := p; exact mk 𝒰 a) x

theorem mk_eq_mk_iff {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} {a : X.unitsH1 𝒰} {b : X.unitsH1 𝒱} :
    mk 𝒰 a = mk 𝒱 b ↔
      ∃ (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒰) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒱),
        unitsRes h₁ a = unitsRes h₂ b :=
  Quotient.eq

/-- Two classes agreeing after restriction to a common refinement are equal; in
particular `mk` is invariant under restriction. -/
@[simp]
theorem mk_unitsRes {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
    mk 𝒱 (unitsRes h a) = mk 𝒰 a :=
  Quotient.sound ⟨𝒱, le_rfl, h, unitsRes_rfl _⟩

private def mulSig (p q : Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
    Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰 :=
  ⟨p.1 ⊓ q.1, unitsRes inf_le_left p.2 * unitsRes inf_le_right q.2⟩
    show mk (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b)
      = mk (𝒱 ⊓ 𝒰) (unitsRes inf_le_left b * unitsRes inf_le_right a)
    refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱, le_rfl, le_inf inf_le_right inf_le_left, ?_⟩
    simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_unitsRes, unitsRes_rfl]
    exact mul_comm _ _

lemma one_def : (1 : X.CechPic) = mk ⊤ 1 :=
  rfl

/-- Multiplication of Picard classes on representatives: restrict both to the common
refinement `𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱` and multiply there. Holds by definition. -/
lemma mk_mul_mk_inf {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) (b : X.unitsH1 𝒱) :
    mk 𝒰 a * mk 𝒱 b
      = mk (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
lemma mk_one (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) : mk 𝒰 (1 : X.unitsH1 𝒰) = 1 :=
  Quotient.sound ⟨𝒰, le_rfl, le_top, by rw [map_one, map_one]⟩

@[simp]
lemma mk_mul_mk (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a b : X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
    mk 𝒰 a * mk 𝒰 b = mk 𝒰 (a * b) := by
  rw [mk_mul_mk_inf]
  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰, le_rfl, inf_le_left, ?_⟩
  simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_rfl]

@[simp]
lemma mk_inv (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) : (mk 𝒰 a)⁻¹ = mk 𝒰 a⁻¹ :=
  rfl

/-! ## Functoriality: pullback of Picard classes -/

private def mapSig (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : Σ 𝒰 : Y.PointedCover, Y.unitsH1 𝒰) :
    Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰 :=
  ⟨p.1.pullback f, f.pullbackUnitsH1 p.1 p.2⟩

private lemma mapSig_compat (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∀ {p q : Σ 𝒰 : Y.PointedCover, Y.unitsH1 𝒰}, p ≈ q → mapSig f p ≈ mapSig f q := by
  rintro ⟨𝒰, a⟩ ⟨𝒱, b⟩ ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩
  refine ⟨𝒲.pullback f, PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₁,
    PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₂, ?_⟩
  show unitsRes (PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₁) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a)
      = unitsRes (PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₂) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒱 b)
  rw [Hom.unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1 f h₁ a, Hom.unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1 f h₂ b, e]

/-- Contravariant functoriality of the Čech Picard group: pull the cover back pointwise,
pull the unit cocycles back through `f`, restrict. -/
def map (f : X ⟶ Y) : Y.CechPic →* X.CechPic where
  toFun := Quotient.map (mapSig f) fun _ _ h ↦ mapSig_compat f h
  map_one' := by
    show mk ((⊤ : Y.PointedCover).pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 ⊤ 1) = 1
    rw [map_one, mk_one]
  map_mul' a b := by
    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
    induction b using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
    show mk ((𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).pullback f)
        (f.pullbackUnitsH1 (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b))
      = mk (𝒰.pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a) *
          mk (𝒱.pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒱 b)
    rw [mk_mul_mk_inf]
    refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨(𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).pullback f, le_rfl,
      le_inf (PointedCover.pullback_mono f inf_le_left)
        (PointedCover.pullback_mono f inf_le_right), ?_⟩
    simp only [map_mul, ← Hom.unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1, unitsRes_unitsRes, unitsRes_rfl]

@[simp]
lemma map_mk (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.PointedCover) (a : Y.unitsH1 𝒰) :
    map f (mk 𝒰 a) = mk (𝒰.pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a) :=
  rfl

/-- Pullback of Picard classes along the identity is the identity. -/
@[simp]
theorem map_id (X : Scheme.{u}) : map (𝟙 X) = MonoidHom.id X.CechPic := by
  refine MonoidHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  induction x using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>

/-- A pointed open cover of a scheme: one open per point, containing it. Pointed covers
are the index discipline of `Scheme.CechPic`: the index type is the carrier of `X` (so
everything stays in `Type u`), refinement is indexwise, and pointwise `⊓` makes the
refinement order directed. -/
structure PointedCover (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u where
  /-- The member of the cover attached to a point. -/
  opens : X → X.Opens
  /-- Each point lies in its member. -/
  mem_opens : ∀ x, x ∈ opens x

namespace PointedCover

@[ext]
lemma ext {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : ∀ x, 𝒰.opens x = 𝒱.opens x) : 𝒰 = 𝒱 := by
  cases 𝒰; cases 𝒱
  simpa using funext h

instance : SemilatticeInf X.PointedCover where
  le 𝒱 𝒰 := ∀ x, 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x
  le_refl 𝒰 x := le_rfl
  le_trans 𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 h₁ h₂ x := (h₁ x).trans (h₂ x)
  le_antisymm 𝒰 𝒱 h₁ h₂ := ext fun x ↦ le_antisymm (h₁ x) (h₂ x)
  inf 𝒰 𝒱 :=
    { opens := fun x ↦ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x
      mem_opens := fun x ↦ ⟨𝒰.mem_opens x, 𝒱.mem_opens x⟩ }
  inf_le_left 𝒰 𝒱 x := inf_le_left
  inf_le_right 𝒰 𝒱 x := inf_le_right
  le_inf 𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 h₁ h₂ x := le_inf (h₁ x) (h₂ x)

instance : OrderTop X.PointedCover where
  top := { opens := fun _ ↦ ⊤, mem_opens := fun _ ↦ trivial }
  le_top _ _ := le_top

lemma le_def {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰 ↔ ∀ x, 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x :=
  Iff.rfl

@[simp]
lemma inf_opens (𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover) (x : X) :
    (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).opens x = 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x :=
  rfl

@[simp]
lemma top_opens (x : X) : (⊤ : X.PointedCover).opens x = ⊤ :=
  rfl

/-- The pullback of a pointed cover along a morphism of schemes: the pointed cover by
preimages, `x ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f x)`. -/
def pullback (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.PointedCover) : X.PointedCover where
  opens x := f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f.base x)
  mem_opens x := 𝒰.mem_opens (f.base x)

@[simp]
lemma pullback_opens (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.PointedCover) (x : X) :
    (𝒰.pullback f).opens x = f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f.base x) :=
  rfl

lemma pullback_mono (f : X ⟶ Y) {𝒰 𝒱 : Y.PointedCover} (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) :
    𝒱.pullback f ≤ 𝒰.pullback f :=
  fun x ↦ ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map f.base).map (homOfLE (h (f.base x)))).le

end PointedCover

/-! ## Unit cocycles on a pointed cover and their restriction -/

/-- The unit-valued Čech 1-cocycles of `X` on a pointed cover. -/
abbrev unitsCocycle (X : Scheme.{u}) (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) : Type u :=
  PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle (X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) 𝒰.opens

/-- The unit-valued Čech `H¹` of `X` on a pointed cover. -/
abbrev unitsH1 (X : Scheme.{u}) (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) : Type u :=
  PresheafOfGroups.H1 (X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) 𝒰.opens

/-- Restriction of unit Čech classes along a refinement of pointed covers, as a group
homomorphism. -/
def unitsRes {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) : X.unitsH1 𝒰 →* X.unitsH1 𝒱 :=
  H1.resHom fun x ↦ homOfLE (h x)

/-- Restriction along refinements of pointed covers is strictly functorial. -/
@[simp]
lemma unitsRes_unitsRes {𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 : X.PointedCover} (h₁ : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒱)
    (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) : unitsRes h₂ (unitsRes h₁ a) = unitsRes (h₂.trans h₁) a :=
  H1.res_res _ _ a

@[simp]
lemma unitsRes_rfl {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} {h : 𝒰 ≤ 𝒰} (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
    unitsRes h a = a :=
  H1.res_id a
/-- If `U` is contained in the preimages of two opens, it is contained in the preimage
of their intersection. -/
lemma Hom.le_preimage_inf (f : X.Hom Y) {U : X.Opens} {V₁ V₂ : Y.Opens}
    (h₁ : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V₁) (h₂ : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V₂) : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (V₁ ⊓ V₂) :=
  fun _ hx ↦ ⟨h₁ hx, h₂ hx⟩

/-- The pair value `γ.evInf i j` of a unit Čech cocycle, retyped as a unit section in
`Γ(X, 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)ˣ` (definitionally equal). Statements phrased through
`unitsEvInf` are honestly `Γ`-typed, so `rw`/`simp` work on them; goals arising from the
`OneCochain` field types are closed against them by `exact` (definitional bridging). -/
def unitsEvInf {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j : X) :
    Γ(X, 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)ˣ :=
  γ.evInf i j

/-- Restriction of a unit section along `W ≤ U`, as a group homomorphism between the
honest `Γ`-typed unit groups (definitionally the units-presheaf restriction map). -/
abbrev unitsRestrict (X : Scheme.{u}) {U W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U) :
    Γ(X, U)ˣ →* Γ(X, W)ˣ :=
  Units.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom

@[simp]
lemma one_unitsEvInf {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (i j : X) :
    unitsEvInf (1 : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) i j = 1 :=
  rfl
